title: ToWorker

AntigravityHarnessDescriptor.description: The Antigravity CLI through `@reeval/harness-antigravity`, made by `antigravity()`.

effort.description: Reasoning effort passed as `agy --effort`, e.g. `low`, `medium`, `high` or `max`. The slug's `-low`/`-medium`/`-high` suffix is the same knob baked into `model`.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `antigravity:<model>`, or `antigravity:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Antigravity attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: A model slug `agy models` lists for a Gemini API key, e.g. `gemini-3.8-flash-medium`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

Budget.description: Run-level caps. `attempts` is checked against the plan; `duration` while running.

attempts.description: The most attempts the plan may have.

duration.description: How long the run may go on, from the first attempt's start.

CaptureOptions.description: Camera defaults for `c.capture()`. Cascades config → profile defaults → group → eval, shallow-merged. `viewport` on a level replaces the whole value. `port` is not an option: pass it as the first argument to `c.capture`.

browser.description: `false` refuses the host `chrome-headless-shell` binary. `c.capture()` then throws.

model.description: Vision model for `instructions`. Cascades like `question`. Default is `analysis.model`, else the attempt's judge model, whichever is first a language model; never Jev.

timeout.description: How long to poll before failing. Default `'60s'`.

viewport.description: The window and saved PNG size, or `'full-page'`. Default 1280×720.

CaptureWindow.description: Live tab size for `c.capture()`. Default 1280×720 when the call and cascade omit `viewport`.

effort.description: Reasoning effort the Agent SDK `/effort` control takes: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` (Extra in the UI) or `max`.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `claude-code:<model>`, or `claude-code:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Claude Code attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the account's rate limits.

model.description: A model id or alias the `claude` CLI accepts, e.g. `claude-sonnet-5` or `sonnet`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

CodexHarnessDescriptor.description: OpenAI's Codex CLI through `@reeval/harness-codex` (`codex exec --json`), made by `codex()`. It runs OpenAI models on an OpenAI API key and reports each turn's tokens, reasoning included.

effort.description: Reasoning effort as Codex's `model_reasoning_effort`, e.g. `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` or `ultra`.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `codex:<model>`, or `codex:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Codex attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: An OpenAI model id Codex runs on the Responses API, e.g. `gpt-5.6-luna`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

ConfigJudgeOptions.description: The config file is plain data sent to workers, so its judge model can't be an object.

gateway.description: The gateway the judge's calls go through, by name or by its helper. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve the model.

maxConcurrent.description: The most judge calls to this model's provider at once, across the run.

providerOptions.description: AI SDK provider options for the judge's calls, keyed by provider.

state.description: The judge's state: what the judge is given beside the question, not the workspace's or the attempt's state. Merged key by key down the cascade.

CursorHarnessDescriptor.description: Cursor's agent through the Cursor TypeScript SDK's local runtime (`@reeval/harness-cursor-sdk`), made by `cursor()`. It reports each turn's tokens.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, mapped onto the catalog param `Cursor.models.list()` names for this model (`reasoning_effort`, `effort`, …). Not Fast: that stays `params.fast`.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `cursor:<model>`, or `cursor:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Cursor attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the account's rate limits.

model.description: A model id `Cursor.models.list()` returns for the key, e.g. `composer-2.5`.

params.description: Model parameters, e.g. `{ fast: 'true' }`. Unset ones take the default variant in Cursor's model catalog, sent explicitly, except `fast`, which is `false` wherever the model takes it.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

DirectGatewayDescriptor.description: Each provider's own key, as without `gateway`: made by `direct()` in `reeval/gateway`.

DockerSandboxDescriptor.description: A local Docker container, made by `docker()`, or a Podman one, made by `podman()`.

capabilities.description: Linux capabilities to add back, e.g. `['NET_RAW']`; every other one is dropped.

cpus.description: CPUs the container may use, fractions allowed. Default 2, capped at the Docker host's.

dockerfile.description: A Dockerfile, absolute or relative to the directory of the file it's written in, built from its directory with `REEVAL_BASE` set to reeval's sandbox image and cached by content hash.

engine.description: The container CLI the sandbox runs on: `podman` for `podman()`, Docker when unset.

from.description: A Debian or Ubuntu based toolchain image; reeval bakes Node and the harness on top, cached.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `docker` (`podman`), or `docker:<image>` for other images, plus an install hash.

image.description: An image that already has the harness baked in, used as is.

install.description: Baked onto the sandbox image in one build container: in order, no secrets, no workspace.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Docker sandboxes at once, across the run, whatever their image.

pids.description: Processes and threads at once. Default 1024.

root.description: Run the agent, setup steps and checks as root, with the capabilities `apt-get` needs, instead of the unprivileged `reeval` user. For evals that install system packages at run time.

swap.description: Swap on top of `memory`, in the same units. Default: as much as `memory`; `0` makes `memory` the hard ceiling. A host without swap has none to give.

Duration.description: More than zero and at most 596h: `90s`, `15m`, `1h`, or a number of milliseconds.

EgressPolicy.description: Where the sandbox may connect: any host over HTTP(S) through the egress gateway (`'proxy'`, the default), anywhere including raw TCP and UDP around the gateway (`'allow-all'`), nowhere (`'deny-all'`), or only the listed hosts (`'*.example.com'` matches subdomains). Under a restricted policy the harness's own hosts, brokered secrets' `hosts` and MCP servers' hosts are allowed too; any other request gets a refusal, and the attempt goes on.

Environment.description: What an eval runs in: the sandbox, skills, MCP servers, files, rules, variables, secrets and setup. Plain data (`layers` root first), plus non-enumerable `extend` / `extendEnvironment`.

extendEnvironment.description: A child environment layered on this one; wherever it sets a key this one has, it wins. `sandbox` is replaced entirely when the child sets one; when the child omits it, the parent's sandbox is kept. This is how two `compare` arms share setup: `compare` itself never layers.

name.description: The name it was defined or extended under, which names its cells.

spec.description: The spec as that layer wrote it, before merging.

EnvironmentSpec.description: What an eval runs in: the declarative, phased spec of one environment.

egress.description: Replaces the inherited policy; an `extend` child's replaces its parent's.

env.description: Variables and secrets for the sandbox, merged by name over the parent's.

mcp.description: MCP servers the agent gets, by name.

plugins.description: Plugins in Claude Code's layout, made by the `plugin` helper; a child's replaces its parent's plugin of the same name.

rules.description: Project rules, written where the harness's agent reads them: `AGENTS.md`, or `CLAUDE.md` for Claude Code.

sandbox.description: Where the attempt runs: `docker()` or `fakeSandbox()`. A child's `extend` / `extendEnvironment` replaces the parent's entirely when it sets one; install is not merged onto the parent image.

setup.description: Shell commands run in every attempt before the agent starts; a child's run after its parent's.

workspace.description: The code the workspace starts as, before `files`, `rules` and `setup`; a child's replaces its parent's.

EnvValue.description: A variable's value: a literal string, or a host secret.

FakeAnalysisModel.description: A canned analysis for tests; see `fakeAnalysis()` in `reeval/judge`.

answer.description: How it answers questions asked of each attempt: a fixed answer, a function of the attempt as the model sees it, or `{ error }` to fail every call. An answer may be `{ choice?, text? }`. Default the first of the question's `choices`, with the text `fake answer`.

output.description: The model's structured answer, or a function of the digest it was given.

vote.description: How it answers pairwise questions: a fixed pick, a function of the blinded pair, or `{ error }` to fail every call. A pick may be `{ winner, reason? }`. Default `'tie'`.

FakeHarnessDescriptor.description: A canned agent for tests and dry runs, made by `fakeHarness()` in `reeval/harness`.

delayMs.description: Simulated turn length, honours the abort signal.

effort.description: Requested reasoning effort, recorded as `effort` on the cell. Use `servedModel` for what the turn reports (`fake-1[effort=medium]`). Fast is not this.

failWith.description: Throw before the first turn starts, to simulate an infra failure.

files.description: Files the fake agent writes into the sandbox on every turn.

flakeRate.description: Chance (0–1) that an attempt writes no files and says so, for flaky pass rates.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

ignoreAbort.description: Sits out `delayMs` even after an abort, like an agent that doesn't stop when it's told to.

layout.description: Behave like this agent: its image, and where it reads rules and skills (`CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/skills` for `claude-code`, `~/.gemini/config/skills` for `antigravity`, `~/.config/opencode/skills` for `opencode`, Goose's private home for `goose`, `~/.pi/agent/skills` for `pi`, `~/.agents/skills` for `codex`, fx's private home for `fx`, Grok's private home for `grok-build`). Defaults to the fake's own (`AGENTS.md`, `.agents/skills`) in Cursor's image.

maxConcurrent.description: The most attempts on this harness kind at once, across the run.

reasoning.description: A reasoning block at the start of every turn.

script.description: Real sandbox actions, one list per `c.send` (the last list repeats), run in order before `files`. `exec` runs as the agent: with the sandbox's own variables, none of the checks'.

servedModel.description: The model the fake agent says served each turn, as a real harness reports its resolved model and variant (`composer-2.5[fast=true]`); unset, it reports none.

startHangs.description: The first this many session starts of an attempt never become ready, even when aborted (`true`: every one).

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

text.description: The fake agent's final message on every turn; default `Done.`.

tools.description: Tool calls the fake agent reports on every turn, before writing files.

withSkill.description: Files and message used instead when the environment gives the agent a skill.

FakeJudgeModel.description: A canned judge for tests and dry runs; see `fakeJudge()` in `reeval/judge`. `score` as a function of the state the judge would see works per group, eval or call, not in the config.

score.description: The score (0–1) every call gets, or a function of the state it would see.

FakeSandboxDescriptor.description: A temp directory on the host instead of a container, made by `fakeSandbox()`.

dir.description: Parent directory for the per-eval workspace (defaults to the OS temp dir).

maxConcurrent.description: The most attempts on this sandbox kind at once, across the run.

FakeScriptStep.description: One action of a scripted fake agent. `exec` is reported as a `shell` tool call whose output is the command's stdout, `write` as file edits, and `reply` is the turn's final message. `mcp` (`'<server>/<tool>'`) starts the environment's stdio MCP server in the sandbox, as an agent would, and calls the tool with no arguments; it's reported as `mcp__<server>__<tool>`. `error` ends the turn there with status `error` and that message, as a provider error would.

FakeVote.description: A blinded label's pick: the attempt shown first (`A`), second (`B`), or neither.

FxHarnessDescriptor.description: fx through `@reeval/harness-fx` (`fx acp`), made by `fx()`. It runs on Vercel AI Gateway or OpenAI's API by the model id, and reports each turn's tokens.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

maxConcurrent.description: The most fx attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: A Vercel AI Gateway model id, `<provider>/<model>`, run on fx's `gateway` provider with `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`, e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`; or a bare OpenAI model id, run on OpenAI's Chat Completions API with `OPENAI_API_KEY`, e.g. `gpt-5.5`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

GatewayDescriptor.description: One entry of the config's `gateway` list.

GatewayName.description: A gateway the config lists by name: `direct` is each provider's own key, as without `gateway`; `vercel` is Vercel AI Gateway; `openrouter` is OpenRouter.

GitWorkspace.description: A git repository (or one directory of it) the workspace starts as, from the `git` helper. `url` is what reeval fetches: the clone URL, or an absolute path for a local repository.

init.description: Give the workspace a `.git`: one commit of the fetched tree, with no remote.

path.description: A directory in the repository whose contents become the workspace.

ref.description: A branch, tag or commit SHA; unset is the remote's `HEAD`.

repo.description: As written: a URL, `github:owner/repo`, or a local path.

token.description: The host variable holding a token for the fetch; read on the host only.

url.description: What reeval fetches: the clone URL, or an absolute path for a local repository.

GooseHarnessDescriptor.description: Goose through `@reeval/harness-goose` (`goose acp`), made by `goose()`. It runs Google models on a Gemini API key, and reports no usage (its ACP server counts one call).

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `goose:<model>`, or `goose:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Goose attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: A Gemini model id, run on Goose's `google` provider, e.g. `gemini-3.8-flash`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

GrokBuildHarnessDescriptor.description: xAI's Grok Build through `@reeval/harness-grok-build` (`grok agent stdio`), made by `grokBuild()`. It runs xAI models on an xAI API key and reports each turn's tokens.

effort.description: Reasoning effort as Grok's `default_reasoning_effort`, e.g. `low`, `medium` or `high`, for a model that takes one.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `grok-build:<model>`, or `grok-build:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Grok Build attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: An xAI model id Grok Build runs on the xAI API, e.g. `grok-4.6`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

HarnessDescriptor.description: The agent an attempt runs: a real harness, or the fake one.

HostFile.description: A file on the host, read when an attempt starts. Made by the `file` helper.

path.description: Its path on the host, absolute or relative to the directory of the file it's written in.

InstallStep.description: A `docker({ install })` command, baked into a cached image layer: no secrets, root, cwd `/`.

JudgeStateOptions.description: What the judge is given: each key is a key of the state in `judge-input.json`. An unset key keeps its default, which is what the judge gets with no `state` option at all.

checks.description: `c.exec` results so far; a list shows only those commands, as passed to `c.exec`. Default false.

contents.description: Workspace files shown whole, as they are now, changed or not: exact paths or gitignore-style patterns (`'**'`, `'src/**'`; the last match wins, `!` excludes) over the files git sees in the workspace. A missing exact path is `null`; a pattern that matches nothing adds nothing. These files leave the diff. Default none.

diff.description: The diff since the eval started. A list is gitignore-style patterns over workspace paths: the last matching pattern wins and `!` excludes. Default true.

files.description: `status path` lines for the changed files, under `diff`'s patterns. Default true.

output.description: The graded turn's final message, or `on`'s value. Default true.

task.description: The graded turn's prompt. Default true.

transcript.description: The graded turn's transcript as text lines: `true` is messages and tool calls with tool output clipped, `'tools'` tool calls only, `'full'` adds reasoning and whole tool output. Default false.

turns.description: `'all'`: every turn up to the graded one under `turns`, each with its task, output and (with `transcript`) transcript. Default `'last'`.

McpServer.description: An MCP server the agent gets, made by the `mcp` helper: a command in the sandbox, or a URL.

command.description: The command that starts the server in the sandbox.

headers.description: Request headers, with secrets brokered by the egress gateway.

transport.description: Streamable HTTP, or the older SSE transport.

OpenCodeHarnessDescriptor.description: OpenCode through `@reeval/harness-opencode` (`opencode acp`), made by `opencode()`. It runs on any provider whose key OpenCode sends in a header on known hosts, with that provider's key, and reports no usage (its ACP server counts one call).

effort.description: Reasoning effort for that provider: `options.reasoningEffort` (OpenAI) or `options.thinking` (Anthropic). Values are whatever that provider takes.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `opencode:<model>`, or `opencode:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most OpenCode attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: OpenCode's model id, `<provider>/<model>`, e.g. `google/gemini-3.8-flash` or `anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5`; the provider picks the key.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

OpenRouterGatewayDescriptor.description: OpenRouter, with `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`: made by `openrouter()` in `reeval/gateway`. It serves Claude Code, Codex, Goose, OpenCode and Grok Build.

fallbacks.description: Let OpenRouter fail over to another upstream provider when the one it picked can't serve a call. Off by default, so reeval's own calls (the judge, analysis, compare questions and captures) send `allow_fallbacks: false`. The harnesses' calls take OpenRouter's own routing either way.

PiHarnessDescriptor.description: pi through `@reeval/harness-pi` (`pi --mode json` in the sandbox), made by `pi()`. It runs Google models on a Gemini API key and reports each model call's tokens. It takes stdio and HTTP MCP servers, not SSE ones.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, passed as pi's `--thinking` (the CLI's name). Values are whatever that flag takes, e.g. `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `pi:<model>`, or `pi:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most pi attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: A Gemini model id, run on pi's `google` provider, e.g. `gemini-3.8-flash`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

PluginMarketplace.description: A Claude Code marketplace: the source that holds its `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.

ref.description: A branch, tag or commit SHA; unset is the remote's `HEAD`.

PluginPart.description: A part of a plugin, as Claude Code's layout bundles it: `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, `agents/<name>.md`, `commands/<name>.md`, `hooks/hooks.json`, `.mcp.json` (or the manifest's `mcpServers`) or `rules/`.

PluginSource.description: A plugin to place for the agent, in Claude Code's layout, made by the `plugin` helper.

build.description: Commands that build the plugin in a Docker image layer, from its directory unless `cwd` says otherwise.

cwd.description: Where they run, relative to the source's root; default the plugin's directory.

run.description: The command, or the commands in order.

only.description: The parts to place; default every part the plugin has.

build.description: Commands that build the plugin in a Docker image layer, from its directory unless `cwd` says otherwise.

cwd.description: Where they run, relative to the source's root; default the plugin's directory.

run.description: The command, or the commands in order.

only.description: The parts to place; default every part the plugin has.

path.description: The plugin's directory in the repository; default its root.

ref.description: A branch, tag or commit SHA; unset is the remote's `HEAD`.

repo.description: As written: a URL, `github:owner/repo`, or a GitHub `/tree/<ref>/<path>` URL.

build.description: Commands that build the plugin in a Docker image layer, from its directory unless `cwd` says otherwise.

cwd.description: Where they run, relative to the source's root; default the plugin's directory.

run.description: The command, or the commands in order.

only.description: The parts to place; default every part the plugin has.

path.description: The plugin's directory in the package; default its root.

build.description: Commands that build the plugin in a Docker image layer, from its directory unless `cwd` says otherwise.

cwd.description: Where they run, relative to the source's root; default the plugin's directory.

run.description: The command, or the commands in order.

marketplace.description: Where the marketplace is: a git repository (at `ref`) or an npm package.

name.description: The plugin's entry in the marketplace's `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.

only.description: The parts to place; default every part the plugin has.

Profile.description: How a run is sized: chosen with `--profile`, `REEVAL_PROFILE` or `defaultProfile`.

defaults.description: What evals get when they don't say otherwise: under groups and evals.

gateway.description: Replaces the config's `gateway` list for this profile's runs.

judge.description: Judge settings for this profile, the same as `defaults.judge`, which wins field by field.

limit.description: Caps over every eval, which only narrow; `pin` on a group or eval skips them.

record.description: When this profile's runs are copied into the history folder.

tags.description: Tag filters for this profile, like `--tag` (`'!slow'` excludes).

ProfileDefaults.description: What evals get when they don't say otherwise: under groups and evals.

capture.description: Screenshot defaults for `c.capture()`, shallow-merged over the config's.

egress.description: Where the sandbox may connect; replaces the config's policy.

env.description: Variables and secrets for the sandbox, merged by name over the config's.

environment.description: What every eval runs in when it names no environment.

gate.description: How each cell's attempts decide its outcome.

harness.description: The agents every eval runs on, unless a group or eval replaces them.

judge.description: Defaults for `c.judge()`, merged field by field over the config's.

question.description: Defaults for every question, merged over the config's.

sandbox.description: The default machine when the resolved environment omits `sandbox`.

ProfileLimit.description: Over every eval, and it can only narrow; `pin` on a group or eval skips it.

compare.description: `false` runs the control only; `{ maxVariants }` keeps the first n variants.

harness.description: Harness ids to allow; evals left with none are skipped.

QuestionOptions.description: Defaults for every question: `model` and `artifacts` replaced, `state` merged key by key.

artifacts.description: Each attempt's own captures, by name; `true` sends all of them. Default none.

model.description: `'provider/model'` that answers every question below it without its own `model`.

state.description: What it's shown of each attempt.

QuestionStateOptions.description: What a question is shown of each attempt: the keys of `judge.state` but `contents` (the attempts' workspaces are gone when questions are asked). An unset key keeps its default: a pairwise question shows the task and the diff; one asked of each attempt also shows the final message and the transcript.

checks.description: `c.exec` results; a list shows only those commands, as passed to `c.exec`. Default false.

diff.description: The diff since the eval started. A list is gitignore-style patterns over workspace paths: the last matching pattern wins and `!` excludes. Default true.

files.description: `status path` lines for the changed files, under `diff`'s patterns. Default false.

output.description: The final message: the agent's own account of its work. Default false in a pair, true per attempt.

task.description: The prompts the attempt was sent, once for both sides when they match. Default true.

transcript.description: The transcript as text lines: `true` is messages and tool calls with tool output clipped, `'tools'` tool calls only, `'full'` adds reasoning and whole tool output. It names each harness's tools, so a pair of two harnesses isn't blind. Default false in a pair, true per attempt.

turns.description: `'all'`: every turn under `turns`, each with its task, output and (with `transcript`) transcript; `'last'`: the last turn only. Default `'all'`.

instructions.description: Added to the prompt, e.g. "Fewer tool calls count as a win. The skill under test is reeval-good."

maxInputTokens.description: The digest's cap; evidence is dropped, lowest priority first, to fit (default 20000).

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens the model may answer with (default 8000). reeval has no prices, so tokens are the cap.

model.description: `'provider/model'`, e.g. `'google/gemini-3.8-flash'`. Unset, `reeval analyze` and questions fall back to the judge's when it's a language model.

concurrency.description: The config's own `concurrency`; see `resolveConcurrency` for the run's.

file.description: The config file as typed from the current directory, or `reeval.config.ts` without one.

gate.description: Unset means `'all'`; kept unset so the plan can hint when `runs > 1`.

gateway.description: The `gateway` list, in preference order; `[direct()]` when the config sets none.

gatewaySet.description: Whether the config sets `gateway`, so the plan shows where each cell resolved.

gateway.description: The gateway the judge's calls go through, by name or by its helper. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve the model.

maxConcurrent.description: The most judge calls to this model's provider at once, across the run.

providerOptions.description: AI SDK provider options for the judge's calls, keyed by provider.

state.description: The judge's state: what the judge is given beside the question, not the workspace's or the attempt's state. Merged key by key down the cascade.

optionKeys.description: The keys the config sets, for `reeval report`'s config shape.

sandbox.description: The default machine when the resolved environment omits `sandbox`. `defineConfig({ sandbox })` sets it; profile defaults, groups and evals cascade over it. Implicit `docker()` when nobody sets one.

ResolvedProfile.description: A profile as the run uses it, with why it was chosen.

gateway.description: The profile's own `gateway` list, which replaces the config's.

completed.description: Attempt keys already finished when this run was resumed; workers register them as skip.

concurrency.description: How many attempts run at once, across the run.

configFile.description: The config file, relative to the current directory, for the debug trace; unset without one.

tags.description: `reeval run --tag` and the profile's tags: each is a tag, or `!tag` to exclude; all must hold.

verbosity.description: `-v` (1) or `-vv`/`--trace` (2) streams the attempts' debug lines; 0 only writes debug.log.

Secret.description: A host environment variable, redacted everywhere reeval writes and recorded by name only. Made by the `secret` helper of `defineEnvironment` and `defineConfig` callbacks.

from.description: The host variable; defaults to the key it's set under.

hosts.description: Brokers the secret: the sandbox gets a per-attempt placeholder, and the Docker egress gateway swaps in the real value only on HTTPS requests to these hosts (`*.example.com` for subdomains).

in.description: Where in a request to those hosts the gateway substitutes; defaults to `['header']`.

optional.description: When the host variable is unset, skip it (the record says so) instead of failing.

to.description: `agent` (default): the container's environment. `checks`: only `c.exec` and `setup` steps.

SecretTemplate.description: `secret.template('Bearer ${TOKEN}')`: host variables substituted into a string, for MCP headers.

template.description: The string, with `${NAME}` for each host variable to substitute.

SetupStep.description: Runs in every attempt before the agent starts, with secrets, outside the eval timeout: a shell command, or `{ run, timeout?, cwd? }`.

cwd.description: Relative to the workspace, or absolute; default the workspace.

SkillPlacement.description: `harness` (default): the agent's own skills, via its adapter. `workspace`: its repo skill dir.

SkillSource.description: Skills to place for the agent, made by the `skill` helper.

exclude.description: Paths in each skill directory to leave out, gitignore-style.

only.description: The skill names to keep; default every one found.

path.description: A host directory with a `SKILL.md`, or a directory of them.

exclude.description: Paths in each skill directory to leave out, gitignore-style.

only.description: The skill names to keep; default every one found.

path.description: The directory in the repository to read skills from.

ref.description: A branch, tag or commit SHA; unset is the remote's `HEAD`.

repo.description: As written: a URL, `github:owner/repo`, or a GitHub `/tree/<ref>/<path>` URL.

version.description: A git ref of the skill's repository.

exclude.description: Paths in each skill directory to leave out, gitignore-style.

only.description: The skill names to keep; default every one found.

path.description: The directory in the package to read skills from; default `skills`.

description.description: The skill's description, as in `SKILL.md`'s frontmatter.

files.description: Other files in the skill directory, by relative path.

name.description: The skill's name, as in `SKILL.md`'s frontmatter.

SubstituteIn.description: `header` values, the `query` string, or the request `body`.

select.description: Collect and exit, or run these tests (by index) and exit.

VercelGatewayDescriptor.description: Vercel AI Gateway, with `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` (else `VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN`): made by `vercel()` in `reeval/gateway`. It serves Claude Code, Codex, Goose, OpenCode, fx and Grok Build.
